shortBio: Systems engineer focused on production software across embedded Linux, high-performance networking, edge AI, and multi-agent AI. I ship across the boundary between hardware and software, with experience in Yocto, RTOS, CUDA, TensorRT, BlueField DPUs, ROS2, and full-stack product delivery.
summary: I write software across the full stack of physical AI. At Ciena, I engineer embedded Linux networking firmware for logistics edge gateways and deploy edge AI inference on NVIDIA Jetson Orin. At Cisco, I built P4-programmable data-plane pipelines and AI traffic intelligence on BlueField DPUs. I started my career at TCS writing bare-metal RTOS firmware for ARM-based telecom edge nodes. On the side, I build Watchpoint, StepAhead, FieldFix, SignalForge, HydraSwarm, and XG1.
